description: The same phrase after the scale is changed to D. At 90 BPM, for four bars, the course project at this stage plays D3, D3, D3 and a softer E3 on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13 with the bass D2 on step 1 and A2 on step 9, the phrase and bass of the last stage moved up a tone by applying a D major scale slot. Listen for the whole part sounding a whole tone higher while keeping its rhythm and its shape.
